$$
{\int }_{1}^{2}[f(t)+\frac{5}{3}g(t)]\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t+\frac{5}{3}{\int }_{1}^{2}g(t)\,\text{d}t.

$$

"From the vector addition and scalar multiplication rules, we have

$$
{\int }_{0}^{1}[6f(t)-2g(t)]\,\text{d}t=6{\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t-2{\int }_{0}^{1}g(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

 

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}[6f(t)-2g(t)]\,\text{d}t & =6{\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t-2{\int }_{0}^{1}g(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =6⟨\frac{1}{2},\,-\frac{2}{3},\,3⟩-2⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩ \\  & =⟨3,\,-4,\,18⟩-⟨2,\,2,\,2⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\,-6,\,16⟩.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-c9391d8f-51c6-50ad-a822-94facfbb487b"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-c9391d8f-51c6-50ad-a822-94facfbb487b" :answer-field/id #uuid "c9391d8f-51c6-50ad-a822-94facfbb487b" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-28a82d4e-66b8-522b-bb29-15ce2137bdbf" :answer-field/choices ["answer-69479ad1-c6b2-5a1b-806d-681f0eb3c7e4" "answer-bb058d20-70c9-58d9-8796-636b8520c920" "answer-28a82d4e-66b8-522b-bb29-15ce2137bdbf" "answer-617f6a04-b5a3-562e-944b-b155e9ef1135" "answer-1b4f82ad-fdb2-5472-91cf-034c72d89d1f"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-69479ad1-c6b2-5a1b-806d-681f0eb3c7e4" :answer/id #uuid "69479ad1-c6b2-5a1b-806d-681f0eb3c7e4" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-1,\,6,\,16⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-bb058d20-70c9-58d9-8796-636b8520c920" :answer/id #uuid "bb058d20-70c9-58d9-8796-636b8520c920" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-5,\,-6,\,20⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-28a82d4e-66b8-522b-bb29-15ce2137bdbf" :answer/id #uuid "28a82d4e-66b8-522b-bb29-15ce2137bdbf" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨1,\,-6,\,16⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-617f6a04-b5a3-562e-944b-b155e9ef1135" :answer/id #uuid "617f6a04-b5a3-562e-944b-b155e9ef1135" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨1,\,6,\,16⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-1b4f82ad-fdb2-5472-91cf-034c72d89d1f" :answer/id #uuid "1b4f82ad-fdb2-5472-91cf-034c72d89d1f" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨5,\,-2,\,20⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186120556 :question/problem "Calculate 
${\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)+⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩\,\text{d}t$
given that
${\int }_{1}^{0}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨-2,\,3,\,4⟩.$" :question/worked-solution "Let's reverse the limits of integration on the known result:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t & =-{\int }_{1}^{0}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =-⟨-2,\,3,\,4⟩ \\  & =⟨2,\,-3,\,-4⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, applying the vector addition rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)+⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{0}^{1}⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩\,\text{d}t \\  & =⟨2,\,-3,\,-4⟩+{⟨t,\,t,\,t⟩|}_{0}^{1} \\  & =⟨2,\,-3,\,-4⟩+⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩\text{ } \\  & =⟨3,\,-2,\,-3⟩.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id 17592186119449 :answer-field/correct "answer-00e985bc-3646-55e6-b3a2-05849e559813" :answer-field/choices ["answer-00e985bc-3646-55e6-b3a2-05849e559813" "answer-7182028f-2b74-5eac-980c-1d5e909f08df" "answer-0c92cdac-b992-5f56-8073-a74a63b8e267" "answer-1431b01c-fbae-5eca-ba0e-3973bfffb5d2" "answer-d2a507f5-177d-52c0-bc32-cfb379389058"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-00e985bc-3646-55e6-b3a2-05849e559813" :answer/id #uuid "00e985bc-3646-55e6-b3a2-05849e559813" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,-2,\,-3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-7182028f-2b74-5eac-980c-1d5e909f08df" :answer/id #uuid "7182028f-2b74-5eac-980c-1d5e909f08df" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,-2,\,1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-0c92cdac-b992-5f56-8073-a74a63b8e267" :answer/id #uuid "0c92cdac-b992-5f56-8073-a74a63b8e267" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,2,\,-1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-1431b01c-fbae-5eca-ba0e-3973bfffb5d2" :answer/id #uuid "1431b01c-fbae-5eca-ba0e-3973bfffb5d2" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨4,\,1,\,-1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-d2a507f5-177d-52c0-bc32-cfb379389058" :answer/id #uuid "d2a507f5-177d-52c0-bc32-cfb379389058" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨4,\,1,\,-3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "question-099cadcd-00ea-506e-8b07-43c526063b36" :question/id #uuid "099cadcd-00ea-506e-8b07-43c526063b36" :question/math-academy-id "q-98263" :question/problem "Calculate 
${\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t$
given that
${\int }_{0}^{4}\frac{1}{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨6,\,-2,\,-4⟩$
and
${\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨3,\,5,\,-7⟩.$" :question/worked-solution "Using the adjacent intervals rule, we have

$$
{\int }_{0}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

We can rearrange the above as follows:

$$
{\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{0}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t
$$

Finally, using the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{0}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =2\cdot {\int }_{0}^{4}\frac{1}{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =2\cdot ⟨6,\,-2,\,-4⟩-⟨3,\,5,\,-7⟩ \\  & =⟨12,\,-4,\,-8⟩-⟨3,\,5,\,-7⟩ \\  & =⟨9,\,-9,\,-1⟩.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-a178f3a9-4495-5692-ab36-8240a8fd4002"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-a178f3a9-4495-5692-ab36-8240a8fd4002" :answer-field/id #uuid "a178f3a9-4495-5692-ab36-8240a8fd4002" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-1bd98d57-852f-5bdb-bd6a-571e37b35316" :answer-field/choices ["answer-13aaa82b-134d-5ac3-8299-d9ab861ac6d5" "answer-15863b1c-cda3-5899-907a-75cfcee2a5c8" "answer-26cb0adc-a799-5679-8285-567c012449b4" "answer-a5e0035b-953e-5269-97ce-c86bb0d7f0b8" "answer-1bd98d57-852f-5bdb-bd6a-571e37b35316"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-13aaa82b-134d-5ac3-8299-d9ab861ac6d5" :answer/id #uuid "13aaa82b-134d-5ac3-8299-d9ab861ac6d5" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-3,\,7,\,-3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-15863b1c-cda3-5899-907a-75cfcee2a5c8" :answer/id #uuid "15863b1c-cda3-5899-907a-75cfcee2a5c8" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨0,\,7,\,-1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-26cb0adc-a799-5679-8285-567c012449b4" :answer/id #uuid "26cb0adc-a799-5679-8285-567c012449b4" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,-9,\,3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-a5e0035b-953e-5269-97ce-c86bb0d7f0b8" :answer/id #uuid "a5e0035b-953e-5269-97ce-c86bb0d7f0b8" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨9,\,-4,\,-5⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-1bd98d57-852f-5bdb-bd6a-571e37b35316" :answer/id #uuid "1bd98d57-852f-5bdb-bd6a-571e37b35316" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨9,\,-9,\,-1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "question-0dd4df5a-0e6b-52af-bfbd-9f8a6a0eb73b" :question/id #uuid "0dd4df5a-0e6b-52af-bfbd-9f8a6a0eb73b" :question/math-academy-id "q-129273" :question/problem "Calculate 
${\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t$
given that
${\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨6,\,-2,\,4⟩$
and
${\int }_{4}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨3,\,-1,\,2⟩.$" :question/worked-solution "Using the adjacent intervals rule, we have

$$
{\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

We can rearrange the above as follows:

$$
{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t
$$

Finally, using the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =-{\int }_{4}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =-⟨3,\,-1,\,2⟩-⟨6,\,-2,\,4⟩ \\  & =⟨-9,\,3,\,-6⟩.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-5fcc12cf-1a92-5a62-8733-9c5f6c91157d"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-5fcc12cf-1a92-5a62-8733-9c5f6c91157d" :answer-field/id #uuid "5fcc12cf-1a92-5a62-8733-9c5f6c91157d" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-d231f7b9-7f46-59da-906f-71bc37334995" :answer-field/choices ["answer-6c26fae9-27e1-5a9e-b8cc-cb6d50822c49" "answer-d231f7b9-7f46-59da-906f-71bc37334995" "answer-bac614d5-c883-5f75-be5e-9a172f5f740e" "answer-bfd1551e-45c9-59c0-b91f-7e4eb6a9ca61" "answer-23bcd99d-a4d7-5113-8122-b434800d4251"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-6c26fae9-27e1-5a9e-b8cc-cb6d50822c49" :answer/id #uuid "6c26fae9-27e1-5a9e-b8cc-cb6d50822c49" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-3,\,-3,\,2⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-d231f7b9-7f46-59da-906f-71bc37334995" :answer/id #uuid "d231f7b9-7f46-59da-906f-71bc37334995" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-9,\,3,\,-6⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-bac614d5-c883-5f75-be5e-9a172f5f740e" :answer/id #uuid "bac614d5-c883-5f75-be5e-9a172f5f740e" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,-3,\,-4⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-bfd1551e-45c9-59c0-b91f-7e4eb6a9ca61" :answer/id #uuid "bfd1551e-45c9-59c0-b91f-7e4eb6a9ca61" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,3,\,-2⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-23bcd99d-a4d7-5113-8122-b434800d4251" :answer/id #uuid "23bcd99d-a4d7-5113-8122-b434800d4251" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨9,\,1,\,-8⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "question-47592607-bdfd-5d8e-9c5b-5217893655c3" :question/id #uuid "47592607-bdfd-5d8e-9c5b-5217893655c3" :question/math-academy-id "q-129271" :question/problem "Calculate 
${\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t$
given that
${\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨15,\,3,\,6⟩$
and
${\int }_{2}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨12,\,2,\,4⟩.$" :question/worked-solution "Using the adjacent intervals rule, we have

$$
{\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{2}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

We can rearrange the above as follows:

$$
{\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{2}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t
$$

Finally, using the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{2}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =⟨15,\,3,\,6⟩-⟨12,\,2,\,4⟩ \\  & =⟨3,\,1,\,2⟩.\end{aligned}

given that

$c=3\,i-5\,j+2\,k.$" :question/worked-solution "The cross-product rule states that

$$

$c=4\,i-j+u\,k,$
and

$$

Applying the dot-product rule, we have

Applying the cross-product rule, we have

$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-648beb9f-469a-53fa-a29e-23cb1da4aeb4"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-648beb9f-469a-53fa-a29e-23cb1da4aeb4" :answer-field/id #uuid "648beb9f-469a-53fa-a29e-23cb1da4aeb4" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-d2c65bc8-479e-5100-94af-a35f364e4685" :answer-field/choices ["answer-a19efb0d-cd16-5561-9b60-33edcdd0cf62" "answer-a3ba84af-5ed3-53ad-87ee-31f41e20153c" "answer-d2c65bc8-479e-5100-94af-a35f364e4685" "answer-656b4822-846d-53ba-8264-7ca1a6236744" "answer-0d99e8a1-d9f3-5f82-af54-6968a95a1bf3"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-a19efb0d-cd16-5561-9b60-33edcdd0cf62" :answer/id #uuid "a19efb0d-cd16-5561-9b60-33edcdd0cf62" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-2\,i+7\,j-4\,k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-a3ba84af-5ed3-53ad-87ee-31f41e20153c" :answer/id #uuid "a3ba84af-5ed3-53ad-87ee-31f41e20153c" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-i+2\,j-3\,k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-d2c65bc8-479e-5100-94af-a35f364e4685" :answer/id #uuid "d2c65bc8-479e-5100-94af-a35f364e4685" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-i-7\,j-2\,k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-656b4822-846d-53ba-8264-7ca1a6236744" :answer/id #uuid "656b4822-846d-53ba-8264-7ca1a6236744" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "2\,i+4\,j-2\,k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-0d99e8a1-d9f3-5f82-af54-6968a95a1bf3" :answer/id #uuid "0d99e8a1-d9f3-5f82-af54-6968a95a1bf3" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "2\,i+7\,j-k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186120995 :tutorial/content "Since the integration of vector functions is done component-by-component, the properties of integrals of vector functions are immediately inherited from those of the integrals of real-valued functions. 

Suppose that $\mathbf f(t)$ and $\mathbf g(t)$ are vector-valued functions that are continuous on a closed interval $[a,b],$ and $\alpha$ is a scalar. 
Then, the *vector addition and scalar multiplication rules* are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{a}^{b}(f(t)+g(t))\text{d}t={\int }_{a}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t\,+\,{\int }_{a}^{b}g(t)\,\text{d}t\, & \text{vector addition rule} \\ {\int }_{a}^{b}\alpha \,f(t)\,\text{d}t=\alpha \,{\int }_{a}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t\, & \text{scalar constant multiple rule}\end{aligned}
$$

  

For example, if $\mathbf f(t) = \left\langle t, \: \cos t\right\rangle$ and $\mathbf g(t) = \left\langle -t^2, \: \sin t \right\rangle,$ then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\int [f(t)+2g(t)]\text{d}t & =\int f(t)\,\text{d}t+2\int g(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\int ⟨t,\,\operatorname{cos}⁡t⟩\,\text{d}t+2\int ⟨-{t}^{2},\,\operatorname{sin}⁡t⟩\,\text{d}t \\  & =⟨\int t\,\text{d}t,\,\int \operatorname{cos}⁡t\,\text{d}t⟩+⟨2\int -{t}^{2}\,\text{d}t,\,2\int \operatorname{sin}⁡t\,\text{d}t⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{{t}^{2}}{2}+{C}_{1},\,\operatorname{sin}⁡t+{C}_{2}⟩+⟨-\frac{2{t}^{3}}{3}+{C}_{3},\,-2\operatorname{cos}⁡t+{C}_{4}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{3{t}^{2}-4{t}^{3}}{6},\,\operatorname{sin}⁡t-2\operatorname{cos}⁡t⟩+C\end{aligned}
$$

  

where $C_1, \, C_2, \, C_3, \, C_4$ are arbitrary real constants and ${\mathbf C} = \langle C_1+C_3, C_2+C_4 \rangle$ is a constant vector." :db/ensure [:tutorial/validate]} {:db/id 17592186119983 :activity/expected-seconds 660.0 :db/ensure [:activity/validate]}]

"From the vector addition and scalar multiplication rules, we have

$$
{\int }_{0}^{1}[6f(t)-2g(t)]\,\text{d}t=6{\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t-2{\int }_{0}^{1}g(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

 

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}[6f(t)-2g(t)]\,\text{d}t & =6{\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t-2{\int }_{0}^{1}g(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =6⟨\frac{1}{2},\,-\frac{2}{3},\,3⟩-2⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩ \\  & =⟨3,\,-4,\,18⟩-⟨2,\,2,\,2⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\,-6,\,16⟩.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-c9391d8f-51c6-50ad-a822-94facfbb487b"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-c9391d8f-51c6-50ad-a822-94facfbb487b" :answer-field/id #uuid "c9391d8f-51c6-50ad-a822-94facfbb487b" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-28a82d4e-66b8-522b-bb29-15ce2137bdbf" :answer-field/choices ["answer-69479ad1-c6b2-5a1b-806d-681f0eb3c7e4" "answer-bb058d20-70c9-58d9-8796-636b8520c920" "answer-28a82d4e-66b8-522b-bb29-15ce2137bdbf" "answer-617f6a04-b5a3-562e-944b-b155e9ef1135" "answer-1b4f82ad-fdb2-5472-91cf-034c72d89d1f"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-69479ad1-c6b2-5a1b-806d-681f0eb3c7e4" :answer/id #uuid "69479ad1-c6b2-5a1b-806d-681f0eb3c7e4" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-1,\,6,\,16⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-bb058d20-70c9-58d9-8796-636b8520c920" :answer/id #uuid "bb058d20-70c9-58d9-8796-636b8520c920" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-5,\,-6,\,20⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-28a82d4e-66b8-522b-bb29-15ce2137bdbf" :answer/id #uuid "28a82d4e-66b8-522b-bb29-15ce2137bdbf" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨1,\,-6,\,16⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-617f6a04-b5a3-562e-944b-b155e9ef1135" :answer/id #uuid "617f6a04-b5a3-562e-944b-b155e9ef1135" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨1,\,6,\,16⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-1b4f82ad-fdb2-5472-91cf-034c72d89d1f" :answer/id #uuid "1b4f82ad-fdb2-5472-91cf-034c72d89d1f" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨5,\,-2,\,20⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186120556 :question/problem "Calculate 
${\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)+⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩\,\text{d}t$
given that
${\int }_{1}^{0}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨-2,\,3,\,4⟩.$" :question/worked-solution "Let's reverse the limits of integration on the known result:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t & =-{\int }_{1}^{0}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =-⟨-2,\,3,\,4⟩ \\  & =⟨2,\,-3,\,-4⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, applying the vector addition rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)+⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{0}^{1}⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩\,\text{d}t \\  & =⟨2,\,-3,\,-4⟩+{⟨t,\,t,\,t⟩|}_{0}^{1} \\  & =⟨2,\,-3,\,-4⟩+⟨1,\,1,\,1⟩\text{ } \\  & =⟨3,\,-2,\,-3⟩.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id 17592186119449 :answer-field/correct "answer-00e985bc-3646-55e6-b3a2-05849e559813" :answer-field/choices ["answer-00e985bc-3646-55e6-b3a2-05849e559813" "answer-7182028f-2b74-5eac-980c-1d5e909f08df" "answer-0c92cdac-b992-5f56-8073-a74a63b8e267" "answer-1431b01c-fbae-5eca-ba0e-3973bfffb5d2" "answer-d2a507f5-177d-52c0-bc32-cfb379389058"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-00e985bc-3646-55e6-b3a2-05849e559813" :answer/id #uuid "00e985bc-3646-55e6-b3a2-05849e559813" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,-2,\,-3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-7182028f-2b74-5eac-980c-1d5e909f08df" :answer/id #uuid "7182028f-2b74-5eac-980c-1d5e909f08df" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,-2,\,1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-0c92cdac-b992-5f56-8073-a74a63b8e267" :answer/id #uuid "0c92cdac-b992-5f56-8073-a74a63b8e267" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,2,\,-1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-1431b01c-fbae-5eca-ba0e-3973bfffb5d2" :answer/id #uuid "1431b01c-fbae-5eca-ba0e-3973bfffb5d2" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨4,\,1,\,-1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-d2a507f5-177d-52c0-bc32-cfb379389058" :answer/id #uuid "d2a507f5-177d-52c0-bc32-cfb379389058" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨4,\,1,\,-3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "question-099cadcd-00ea-506e-8b07-43c526063b36" :question/id #uuid "099cadcd-00ea-506e-8b07-43c526063b36" :question/math-academy-id "q-98263" :question/problem "Calculate 
${\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t$
given that
${\int }_{0}^{4}\frac{1}{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨6,\,-2,\,-4⟩$
and
${\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨3,\,5,\,-7⟩.$" :question/worked-solution "Using the adjacent intervals rule, we have

$$
{\int }_{0}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

We can rearrange the above as follows:

$$
{\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{0}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t
$$

Finally, using the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{0}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =2\cdot {\int }_{0}^{4}\frac{1}{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =2\cdot ⟨6,\,-2,\,-4⟩-⟨3,\,5,\,-7⟩ \\  & =⟨12,\,-4,\,-8⟩-⟨3,\,5,\,-7⟩ \\  & =⟨9,\,-9,\,-1⟩.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-a178f3a9-4495-5692-ab36-8240a8fd4002"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-a178f3a9-4495-5692-ab36-8240a8fd4002" :answer-field/id #uuid "a178f3a9-4495-5692-ab36-8240a8fd4002" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-1bd98d57-852f-5bdb-bd6a-571e37b35316" :answer-field/choices ["answer-13aaa82b-134d-5ac3-8299-d9ab861ac6d5" "answer-15863b1c-cda3-5899-907a-75cfcee2a5c8" "answer-26cb0adc-a799-5679-8285-567c012449b4" "answer-a5e0035b-953e-5269-97ce-c86bb0d7f0b8" "answer-1bd98d57-852f-5bdb-bd6a-571e37b35316"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-13aaa82b-134d-5ac3-8299-d9ab861ac6d5" :answer/id #uuid "13aaa82b-134d-5ac3-8299-d9ab861ac6d5" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-3,\,7,\,-3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-15863b1c-cda3-5899-907a-75cfcee2a5c8" :answer/id #uuid "15863b1c-cda3-5899-907a-75cfcee2a5c8" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨0,\,7,\,-1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-26cb0adc-a799-5679-8285-567c012449b4" :answer/id #uuid "26cb0adc-a799-5679-8285-567c012449b4" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,-9,\,3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-a5e0035b-953e-5269-97ce-c86bb0d7f0b8" :answer/id #uuid "a5e0035b-953e-5269-97ce-c86bb0d7f0b8" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨9,\,-4,\,-5⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-1bd98d57-852f-5bdb-bd6a-571e37b35316" :answer/id #uuid "1bd98d57-852f-5bdb-bd6a-571e37b35316" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨9,\,-9,\,-1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "question-0dd4df5a-0e6b-52af-bfbd-9f8a6a0eb73b" :question/id #uuid "0dd4df5a-0e6b-52af-bfbd-9f8a6a0eb73b" :question/math-academy-id "q-129273" :question/problem "Calculate 
${\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t$
given that
${\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨6,\,-2,\,4⟩$
and
${\int }_{4}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨3,\,-1,\,2⟩.$" :question/worked-solution "Using the adjacent intervals rule, we have

$$
{\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

We can rearrange the above as follows:

$$
{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t
$$

Finally, using the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =-{\int }_{4}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{1}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =-⟨3,\,-1,\,2⟩-⟨6,\,-2,\,4⟩ \\  & =⟨-9,\,3,\,-6⟩.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-5fcc12cf-1a92-5a62-8733-9c5f6c91157d"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-5fcc12cf-1a92-5a62-8733-9c5f6c91157d" :answer-field/id #uuid "5fcc12cf-1a92-5a62-8733-9c5f6c91157d" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-d231f7b9-7f46-59da-906f-71bc37334995" :answer-field/choices ["answer-6c26fae9-27e1-5a9e-b8cc-cb6d50822c49" "answer-d231f7b9-7f46-59da-906f-71bc37334995" "answer-bac614d5-c883-5f75-be5e-9a172f5f740e" "answer-bfd1551e-45c9-59c0-b91f-7e4eb6a9ca61" "answer-23bcd99d-a4d7-5113-8122-b434800d4251"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-6c26fae9-27e1-5a9e-b8cc-cb6d50822c49" :answer/id #uuid "6c26fae9-27e1-5a9e-b8cc-cb6d50822c49" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-3,\,-3,\,2⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-d231f7b9-7f46-59da-906f-71bc37334995" :answer/id #uuid "d231f7b9-7f46-59da-906f-71bc37334995" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-9,\,3,\,-6⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-bac614d5-c883-5f75-be5e-9a172f5f740e" :answer/id #uuid "bac614d5-c883-5f75-be5e-9a172f5f740e" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,-3,\,-4⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-bfd1551e-45c9-59c0-b91f-7e4eb6a9ca61" :answer/id #uuid "bfd1551e-45c9-59c0-b91f-7e4eb6a9ca61" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,3,\,-2⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-23bcd99d-a4d7-5113-8122-b434800d4251" :answer/id #uuid "23bcd99d-a4d7-5113-8122-b434800d4251" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨9,\,1,\,-8⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "question-47592607-bdfd-5d8e-9c5b-5217893655c3" :question/id #uuid "47592607-bdfd-5d8e-9c5b-5217893655c3" :question/math-academy-id "q-129271" :question/problem "Calculate 
${\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t$
given that
${\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨15,\,3,\,6⟩$
and
${\int }_{2}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨12,\,2,\,4⟩.$" :question/worked-solution "Using the adjacent intervals rule, we have

$$
{\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{2}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

We can rearrange the above as follows:

$$
{\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{2}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t
$$

Finally, using the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{1}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{2}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =⟨15,\,3,\,6⟩-⟨12,\,2,\,4⟩ \\  & =⟨3,\,1,\,2⟩.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-1ce4d30d-9663-5cde-be1f-6bc470206c3c"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-1ce4d30d-9663-5cde-be1f-6bc470206c3c" :answer-field/id #uuid "1ce4d30d-9663-5cde-be1f-6bc470206c3c" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-1cb8259f-8c90-5906-950d-4eceda1af95a" :answer-field/choices ["answer-a45f0695-37ea-5976-9377-b321aab76838" "answer-3577fefa-4330-511f-bfb5-e3b0bdd5b2d7" "answer-aaf3598f-9c3e-57f6-8286-eee1de57ab13" "answer-9bb2546e-95e7-5c4f-8882-4b1f0f221022" "answer-1cb8259f-8c90-5906-950d-4eceda1af95a"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-a45f0695-37ea-5976-9377-b321aab76838" :answer/id #uuid "a45f0695-37ea-5976-9377-b321aab76838" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-1,\,-5,\,3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-3577fefa-4330-511f-bfb5-e3b0bdd5b2d7" :answer/id #uuid "3577fefa-4330-511f-bfb5-e3b0bdd5b2d7" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-1,\,5,\,3⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-aaf3598f-9c3e-57f6-8286-eee1de57ab13" :answer/id #uuid "aaf3598f-9c3e-57f6-8286-eee1de57ab13" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-3,\,-1,\,1⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-9bb2546e-95e7-5c4f-8882-4b1f0f221022" :answer/id #uuid "9bb2546e-95e7-5c4f-8882-4b1f0f221022" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨-3,\,3,\,2⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-1cb8259f-8c90-5906-950d-4eceda1af95a" :answer/id #uuid "1cb8259f-8c90-5906-950d-4eceda1af95a" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "⟨3,\,1,\,2⟩" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "question-9dfd8a34-cf86-59cc-aba6-9a0a73cfe2af" :question/id #uuid "9dfd8a34-cf86-59cc-aba6-9a0a73cfe2af" :question/math-academy-id "q-129296" :question/problem "Find ${\int }_{0}^{2}c\times f(t)\,\text{d}t$ 
given that 
${\int }_{0}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t=7\,i-4\,j-k$ 
and 
$c=3\,i-5\,j+2\,k.$" :question/worked-solution "The cross-product rule states that

$$
{\int }_{0}^{2}c\times f(t)\,\text{d}t=c\times {\int }_{0}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

 

Applying the cross-product rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}c\times f(t)\,\text{d}t & =c\times {\int }_{0}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =(3\,i-5\,j+2\,k)\times (7\,i-4\,j-k) \\  & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 3 & -5 & 2 \\ 7 & -4 & -1\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 \\ -4 & -1\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 7 & -1\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}3 & -5 \\ 7 & -4\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(5+8)i-(-3-14)j+(-12+35)k \\  & =13\,i+17\,j+23\,k.\end{aligned}

Applying the cross-product rule, we have

$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-648beb9f-469a-53fa-a29e-23cb1da4aeb4"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-648beb9f-469a-53fa-a29e-23cb1da4aeb4" :answer-field/id #uuid "648beb9f-469a-53fa-a29e-23cb1da4aeb4" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-d2c65bc8-479e-5100-94af-a35f364e4685" :answer-field/choices ["answer-a19efb0d-cd16-5561-9b60-33edcdd0cf62" "answer-a3ba84af-5ed3-53ad-87ee-31f41e20153c" "answer-d2c65bc8-479e-5100-94af-a35f364e4685" "answer-656b4822-846d-53ba-8264-7ca1a6236744" "answer-0d99e8a1-d9f3-5f82-af54-6968a95a1bf3"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-a19efb0d-cd16-5561-9b60-33edcdd0cf62" :answer/id #uuid "a19efb0d-cd16-5561-9b60-33edcdd0cf62" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-2\,i+7\,j-4\,k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-a3ba84af-5ed3-53ad-87ee-31f41e20153c" :answer/id #uuid "a3ba84af-5ed3-53ad-87ee-31f41e20153c" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-i+2\,j-3\,k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-d2c65bc8-479e-5100-94af-a35f364e4685" :answer/id #uuid "d2c65bc8-479e-5100-94af-a35f364e4685" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-i-7\,j-2\,k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-656b4822-846d-53ba-8264-7ca1a6236744" :answer/id #uuid "656b4822-846d-53ba-8264-7ca1a6236744" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "2\,i+4\,j-2\,k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-0d99e8a1-d9f3-5f82-af54-6968a95a1bf3" :answer/id #uuid "0d99e8a1-d9f3-5f82-af54-6968a95a1bf3" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "2\,i+7\,j-k" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186120995 :tutorial/content "Since the integration of vector functions is done component-by-component, the properties of integrals of vector functions are immediately inherited from those of the integrals of real-valued functions. 

Suppose that $\mathbf f(t)$ and $\mathbf g(t)$ are vector-valued functions that are continuous on a closed interval $[a,b],$ and $\alpha$ is a scalar. 
Then, the *vector addition and scalar multiplication rules* are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{a}^{b}(f(t)+g(t))\text{d}t={\int }_{a}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t\,+\,{\int }_{a}^{b}g(t)\,\text{d}t\, & \text{vector addition rule} \\ {\int }_{a}^{b}\alpha \,f(t)\,\text{d}t=\alpha \,{\int }_{a}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t\, & \text{scalar constant multiple rule}\end{aligned}
$$

  

For example, if $\mathbf f(t) = \left\langle t, \: \cos t\right\rangle$ and $\mathbf g(t) = \left\langle -t^2, \: \sin t \right\rangle,$ then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\int [f(t)+2g(t)]\text{d}t & =\int f(t)\,\text{d}t+2\int g(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\int ⟨t,\,\operatorname{cos}⁡t⟩\,\text{d}t+2\int ⟨-{t}^{2},\,\operatorname{sin}⁡t⟩\,\text{d}t \\  & =⟨\int t\,\text{d}t,\,\int \operatorname{cos}⁡t\,\text{d}t⟩+⟨2\int -{t}^{2}\,\text{d}t,\,2\int \operatorname{sin}⁡t\,\text{d}t⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{{t}^{2}}{2}+{C}_{1},\,\operatorname{sin}⁡t+{C}_{2}⟩+⟨-\frac{2{t}^{3}}{3}+{C}_{3},\,-2\operatorname{cos}⁡t+{C}_{4}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{3{t}^{2}-4{t}^{3}}{6},\,\operatorname{sin}⁡t-2\operatorname{cos}⁡t⟩+C\end{aligned}
$$

  

where $C_1, \, C_2, \, C_3, \, C_4$ are arbitrary real constants and ${\mathbf C} = \langle C_1+C_3, C_2+C_4 \rangle$ is a constant vector." :db/ensure [:tutorial/validate]} {:db/id 17592186119983 :activity/expected-seconds 660.0 :db/ensure [:activity/validate]}] "assertions" [["question-8fc5a0e9-33d2-5427-a227-a63b18c415e2" :question/id #uuid "8fc5a0e9-33d2-5427-a227-a63b18c415e2"] ["question-8fc5a0e9-33d2-5427-a227-a63b18c415e2" :question/math-academy-id "q-129151"] ["question-8fc5a0e9-33d2-5427-a227-a63b18c415e2" :question/problem "Calculate ${\int }_{1}^{2}[f(t)+\frac{5}{3}g(t)]\text{d}t$ given that ${\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨-2,\,1,\,4⟩$ and ${\int }_{1}^{2}g(t)\,\text{d}t=⟨-3,\,6,\,0⟩.$"] ["question-8fc5a0e9-33d2-5427-a227-a63b18c415e2" :question/worked-solution "From the vector addition and scalar multiplication rules, we have

$$
{\int }_{1}^{2}[f(t)+\frac{5}{3}g(t)]\text{d}t={\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t+\frac{5}{3}{\int }_{1}^{2}g(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}[f(t)+\frac{5}{3}g(t)]\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{1}^{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t+\frac{5}{3}{\int }_{1}^{2}g(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =⟨-2,\,1,\,4⟩+\frac{5}{3}⟨-3,\,6,\,0⟩ \\  & =⟨-2,\,1,\,4⟩+⟨-5,\,10,\,0⟩ \\  & =⟨-7,\,11,\,4⟩.\end{aligned}
$$"] ["question-8fc5a0e9-33d2-5427-a227-a63b18c415e2" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] ["answer-field-b5ee2c23-f39d-50cc-8ad6-40fbb0395dc9" :answer-field/id #uuid "Calculate 
${\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t$
given that

$$
{\int }_{0}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

We can rearrange the above as follows:

$$
{\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{0}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t
$$

Finally, using the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{0}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =2\cdot {\int }_{0}^{4}\frac{1}{2}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{3}^{4}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =2\cdot ⟨6,\,-2,\,-4⟩-⟨3,\,5,\,-7⟩ \\  & =⟨12,\,-4,\,-8⟩-⟨3,\,5,\,-7⟩ \\  & =⟨9,\,-9,\,-1⟩.\end{aligned}
$$"] ["question-099cadcd-00ea-506e-8b07-43c526063b36" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["answer-field-a178f3a9-4495-5692-ab36-8240a8fd4002" :answer-field/id #uuid $$"] ["question-9dfd8a34-cf86-59cc-aba6-9a0a73cfe2af" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["answer-field-cd206ea4-1fa4-5b1a-b95a-d7f9dcd15b33" :answer-field/id #uuid $$

$$

$$

integration of vector functions is done component-by-component, the properties of integrals of vector functions are immediately inherited from those of the integrals of real-valued functions. 

Suppose that $\mathbf f(t)$ and $\mathbf g(t)$ are vector-valued functions that are continuous on a closed interval $[a,b],$ and $\alpha$ is a scalar.

$\displaystyle\int_{-1}^0\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm{d}t$
given that
$\displaystyle\int_0^1\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm{d}t= \left\langle \dfrac{3}{2}, \: 1, \: 3 \right\rangle$
and
$\displaystyle\int_{-1}^1\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm{d}t=\left\langle 0, \: 2, \: 6 \right\rangle.$" :question/worked-solution "Using the adjacent intervals, we get

$$
\int_{-1}^1\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm{d}t=\int_{-1}^0\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm{d}t+\int_0^1\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm{d}t .
$$

We can rearrange the above as follows:

$$
\int_{-1}^0\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm{d}t = 
\int_{-1}^1\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm{d}t - \int_0^1\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm{d}t
$$

Finally, using the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-1}^{0}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t-{\int }_{0}^{1}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =⟨0,\,2,\,6⟩-⟨\frac{3}{2},\,1,\,3⟩ \\  & =⟨-\frac{3}{2},\,1,\,3⟩.\end{aligned}
$$"} {:db/id 17592186120180 :question/id #uuid "ae97662d-9168-5c3a-9fc4-a2e6f16a2143" :question/math-academy-id "q-32516"} {:db/id 17592186120555 :question/id #uuid "29982efe-8588-56f9-8a2e-657a512dab79" :question/math-academy-id "q-96943" :knowledge-point/_questions [{:db/id 17592186119981 :knowledge-point/id #uuid "d5287f63-6d1a-5710-8a71-df5d1ba09a00" :knowledge-point/title "Applying the Adjacent Intervals Rule"}] :question/answer-fields [{:answer-field/choices [{:answer/id #uuid "46bf7675-80a2-559b-8162-709a1a0d7f2f" :answer/type {:db/id 17592186045498 :db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "⟨10,\,6,\,1⟩" :db/id 17592186358358} {:answer/id #uuid "52b55dd5-256e-5209-86de-a9c9700d2990" :answer/type {:db/id 17592186045498 :db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "⟨7,\,2,\,11⟩" :db/id 17592186358461} {:answer/id #uuid "90b044f6-737d-5f41-adc8-0bdca392f181" :answer/type {:db/id 17592186045498 :db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "⟨-10,\,9,\,-11⟩" :db/id 17592186359017} {:answer/id #uuid "e6dcc4aa-84e5-52fb-b4ea-896d476393a3" :answer/type {:db/id 17592186045498 :db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "⟨9,\,1,\,-1⟩" :db/id 17592186359794} {:answer/id #uuid "ec412725-0d94-59a0-8fbf-bf17919c936a" :answer/type {:db/id 17592186045498 :db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "⟨-1,\,-3,\,11⟩" :db/id 17592186359855}] :answer-field/correct {:answer/id #uuid "90b044f6-737d-5f41-adc8-0bdca392f181" :answer/type {:db/id 17592186045498 :db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "⟨-10,\,9,\,-11⟩" :db/id 17592186359017} :answer-field/id #uuid "e3e28b5a-b897-5ddd-a2bd-d85b9a72bf4f" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type {:db/id 17592186045493 :db/ident :answer-field.type/radio} :db/id 17592186360402}] :question/difficulty {:db/id 17592186045485 :db/ident :question.difficulty/easy} :question/problem "Calculate

:knowledge-point/title "Applying the Product Rules"}] :question/problem "Find $\displaystyle {\int_0^1 }  \mathbf c \times \mathbf f(t)  \, \textrm d t$ 
given that 
$\displaystyle\int_0^1\mathbf f(t)\,\textrm d t = \mathbf i-3\,\mathbf j-4\,\mathbf k$ 
and 
$\mathbf c=\mathbf j-\mathbf k .$" :question/worked-solution "The cross-product rule states that

$$
{\int_0^1 } \mathbf c \times \mathbf f(t) \, \textrm d t =  \mathbf c \times {\int_0^1 } \mathbf f(t) \, \textrm d t  .
$$

 

Applying the cross-product rule, we have

$$

$$" :tutorial/id #uuid "43078f08-37bf-59a3-8462-3b3efc865eb1" :tutorial/math-academy-id 5177 :tutorial/title "The Rule for Reversal of Integration Limits"} :step/id #uuid "660b20a9-f073-51b0-a1b7-e72f161ebfb3" :step/math-academy-id 32530 :step/next {:db/id 17592186120789}} {:db/id 17592186120791 :step/content {:db/id 17592186121080 :tutorial/content "Given a vector-valued function $\mathbf f(t)$ that is continuous on a closed interval $[a,b]$ and $p \in (a,b),$ the *adjacent intervals rule* states the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{a}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t={\int }_{a}^{p}f(t)\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{p}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t\end{aligned}
$$" :tutorial/id #uuid "ef0617f3-7ee0-5300-8795-10adbdc19d3b" :tutorial/math-academy-id 5178 :tutorial/title "The Adjacent Intervals Rule"} :step/id #uuid "84aafb0e-a1fc-506a-aa26-8b23e04c1756" :step/math-academy-id 32531 :step/next {:db/id 17592186120978}} {:db/id 17592186120792 :step/content {:db/id 17592186121081 :tutorial/content "Suppose that $\mathbf f(t)$ is a vector-valued function that is continuous on a closed interval $[a,b]$ and $\mathbf c$ is a constant vector. 
Then, the *products rules* are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{a}^{b}[c\cdot f(t)]\text{d}t=c\cdot ({\int }_{a}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t)\, & \text{dot product rule} \\ {\int }_{a}^{b}[c\times f(t)]\text{d}t=c\times {\int }_{a}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t\, & \text{cross product rule}\end{aligned}
$$" :tutorial/id #uuid "2531e67a-b5ed-5052-a97f-34abca386c58" :tutorial/math-academy-id 5179 :tutorial/title "The Product Rules"} :step/id #uuid "60fca522-e8ee-530d-9936-cc7ec084b35f" :step/math-academy-id 32532 :step/next {:db/id 17592186120979}} {:db/id 17592186120976 :step/content {:db/id 17592186120995 :tutorial/content "Since the integration of vector functions is done component-by-component, the properties of integrals of vector functions are immediately inherited from those of the integrals of real-valued functions. 

Suppose that $\mathbf f(t)$ and $\mathbf g(t)$ are vector-valued functions that are continuous on a closed interval $[a,b],$ and $\alpha$ is a scalar. 
Then, the *vector addition and scalar multiplication rules* are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{a}^{b}(f(t)+g(t))\text{d}t={\int }_{a}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t\,+\,{\int }_{a}^{b}g(t)\,\text{d}t\, & \text{vector addition rule} \\ {\int }_{a}^{b}\alpha \,f(t)\,\text{d}t=\alpha \,{\int }_{a}^{b}f(t)\,\text{d}t\, & \text{scalar constant multiple rule}\end{aligned}
$$

 

For example, if $\mathbf f(t) = \left\langle t, \: \cos t\right\rangle$ and $\mathbf g(t) = \left\langle -t^2, \: \sin t \right\rangle,$ then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\int [f(t)+2g(t)]\text{d}t & =\int f(t)\,\text{d}t+2\int g(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\int ⟨t,\,\operatorname{cos}t⟩\,\text{d}t+2\int ⟨-{t}^{2},\,\operatorname{sin}t⟩\,\text{d}t \\  & =⟨\int t\,\text{d}t,\,\int \operatorname{cos}t\,\text{d}t⟩+⟨2\int -{t}^{2}\,\text{d}t,\,2\int \operatorname{sin}t\,\text{d}t⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{{t}^{2}}{2}+{C}_{1},\,\operatorname{sin}t+{C}_{2}⟩+⟨-\frac{2{t}^{3}}{3}+{C}_{3},\,-2\operatorname{cos}t+{C}_{4}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{3{t}^{2}-4{t}^{3}}{6},\,\operatorname{sin}t-2\operatorname{cos}t⟩+C\end{aligned}
$$

 

where $C_1, \, C_2, \, C_3, \, C_4$ are arbitrary real constants and ${\mathbf C} = \langle C_1+C_3, C_2+C_4 \rangle$ is a constant vector." :tutorial/id #uuid "b3d07bd2-8d66-5645-a140-c638f5e9f002" Students then study multiple integration, focusing on double integrals and coordinate transformations such as polar coordinates. These techniques allow the computation of physical quantities distributed over regions, such as mass, charge, or probability density.
The final portion of the course introduces differential equations as models of dynamical systems. Students study first-order equations and qualitative behavior of solutions through phase-line analysis. Applications include motion under drag, gravitational attraction, electrical circuits, and population dynamics.
